thread:
Samira Patel: Quick heads-up — running a short series of enablement office-hours for VelocityHealth next week. Need trainer coverage + a tight agenda. TL;DR: 3x 60m sessions Tue/Wed/Thu 4:00–5:00pm PT (23:00–00:00 UTC). Attendees ~8. Who can own Wed? Also want a 10min pre-read and a feedback form.

Kai Gomez: I can take Tue (4pm PT). Will add to my calendar. Do we want the Tue slot to be general onboarding vs. migration deep-dive?

Maria Li: I’ll own Thu. FYI Thu 4pm PT is late for me (EMEA morning) but ok. Need someone for Wed morning split or cover.

Owen Park: @Samira I can split Wed with Evelyn — I’ll do first 30m onboarding checklist + account config; Evelyn can do advanced prompts and demo labs second 30m.

Evelyn Chen: Yep I’ll take the second half Wed. I’ll prep a prompt gallery + 3 short labs. @Samira can you drop a couple of Velocity-specific prompts or example workflows so I can tailor labs?

Samira Patel: Added a tiny prework doc (internal): https://redwood.internal/docs/vel-health-prework — please don’t share externally. Created a draft calendar invite: https://calendar.redwood.com/e/abc123
Agenda (draft):
```
00:00-00:10 — Welcome + goals (Samira)
00:10-00:30 — Onboarding checklist + account review (Owen)
00:30-00:55 — Prompt patterns & labs (Evelyn)
00:55-01:00 — Next steps + feedback link (CS Ops)
```
We should record each session and drop transcripts.

Kai Gomez: Suggestion: Tue = product intro + account checks, Wed = live prompt workshop (hands-on), Thu = migration checklist for Dedicated->Private. Thoughts?

CS Bot: Reminder: include recording + transcript capture in the invite metadata so CS Ops can auto-upload to the customer's workspace. :robot_face:

Sam (Velocity PM): Thanks — Velocity team prefers Tue & Thu as priority. Wed is OK if we have strong attendance. Could we do a quick poll to confirm Wed interest?

Maria Li: Quick 1-click reaction poll here: :thumbsup: = attending Tue, :eyes: = Wed, :rocket: = Thu. Please react so we can cancel Wed if low interest.

Owen Park: :thumbsup: for Tue (backup), :rocket: for Thu. I’ll update my slides and labs by Monday midday.

Evelyn Chen: Materials done — 2 demo notebooks + a short slide deck. Feedback form created: https://forms.redwood.com/vel-feedback

Samira Patel: Perfect. I’ll send final invites, add prework (10min), and include recording/transcript flags. If Wed < 3 reactions by EOD Fri we’ll cancel and reallocate trainers. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:

CS Ops: Noted — will enable auto-record + upload, add captioning, and link form to the workspace after each session. Will also capture attendance counts and pass to renewal health dashboard.

Samira Patel: Closing loop — invites out, calendar shows Tue/Thu confirmed, Wed tentative pending poll. Will post final status Monday AM.
